tests.name: triage_grepany

weaknesses.title: LET end is illegal — END is reserved block terminator
weaknesses.detail: LET end = start + PSIZE parses as unknown form ''. Any var named end/END breaks agents writing page windows. Must use page_end/end_i. No clear error naming reserved words.

weaknesses.title: GREPANY multi-needle bag argument does not expand fields
weaknesses.detail: SYS GREPANY bag needles with needles='ERROR\nWARN' yields 0 hits. Need separate string args GREPANY bag "ERROR" "WARN". Agents building needle bags from ENV fail silently.
weaknesses.repro: GREPANY log needles_bag → empty; GREPANY log "ERROR" "WARN" → hits

weaknesses.title: TRIMALL leaves empty fields for former whitespace lines
weaknesses.detail: All-space field becomes empty field; SQUEEZE BLANK required to drop. Depth can still include empties after trim-only.

weaknesses.title: MIDLINES OOR returns empty soft without FAIL sticky
weaknesses.detail: start past end → empty bag OK. Good for paging but agents must check LINES; program uses REQUIRE for hard miss.

weaknesses.title: TRIMALL/MIDLINES/GREPANY non-mutate named bags
weaknesses.detail: Must LET bag = LAST after trim or WRITE keeps dirty whitespace.
weaknesses.repro: TRIMALL bag; LINES bag still dirty without LET

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line log bags/windows
weaknesses.detail: Window and full bag unparseable in one JSON string field.

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
GREPANY still substring-unsafe
weaknesses.detail: Needle error matches error soft miss. Same GREP class.

workarounds: Never name vars end/END/IF/THEN — use page_end
GREPANY with quoted separate needles not bag of needles
TRIMALL then SQUEEZE BLANK for clean log plates
Check LINES after MIDLINES; REQUIRE for hard page OOR
Always LET bag = LAST after TRIMALL/MIDLINES/GREPANY
language_gaps: Clear reserved-word diagnostic on LET end
GREPANY needles from bag (expand fields as needles)
issues_faced: LET end reserved keyword broke entire program until renamed page_end
Also found LET end = start + PSIZE - 1 chained minus awkward; split to two LETs
GREPANY bag-of-needles silent empty — documented W2
